runner: local rootful Docker with host-visible global raw sys_enter attachment
unrelated_workload: a CPU-pinned shell loop reopening and reading /proc/self/stat for three seconds
attachment_handshake: the probe waits for the benchmark-only /artifacts/attachment-ready file, emitted only after Tier E installAndAttach succeeds

promotion_gate.required: at least 15% added unrelated-host CPU cost with a paired confidence interval excluding zero and complete target evidence
promotion_gate.reason: deltas have mixed signs and the median does not approach the 15% threshold; the observed variation cannot support a scoped-tracepoint promotion claim

decision: Do not implement the per-platform-TID perf-event attachment prototype. Retain the global raw sys_enter tracepoint and revisit only with a materially different host-noise hypothesis.
limitations: The worker is an intentionally dependency-free syscall-rate probe, not an application-wide node-load simulator.
The failure to meet the promotion gate is sufficient to reject the risky scoped-attachment prototype; it is not proof that global attachment has zero cost on every kernel or workload.
